newsitem.title: USA: Owens & Minor says growth rate hard to keep.
newsitem.headline: Owens & Minor says growth rate hard to keep.

text.p: Owens & Minor, which reported a sharp improvement in second quarter earnings, said on Wednesday that its earnings growth rate will be difficult to maintain.

"Maintaining the rate of our recent earnings growth in upcoming quarters will become successively harder. Yet we are determined to keep on track," G. Gilmer Minor, chairman, president and chief executive, said in a statement.

"For the first six months of 1997, we are right on target with our goal to show steady earnings growth. Sales this quarter are up by 3.6 percent when compared to the same period last year. We are hopeful we can nudge that sales growth up a bit more in the second half of this year," Minor said.
The distributor of medical supplies said it has improved its gross margin as a percentage of sales to 10 percent in the second quarter from 9.9 percent in the year ago period.
